description: Read what is stored for one more language of the excellence roadmap: the name, description, levels, themes and items in that language, an empty string where a text is not translated yet, and how many texts are still missing. Read it before translate_roadmap, with get_excellence_roadmap in the source language for the texts to translate and their ids.

locale.description: The language to read; never the source language of the roadmap

roadmap_id.description: UUID of the roadmap; optional when the organization has one

name: get_roadmap_translation
title: Get a roadmap translation
